symptom: The Draft 2020-12 shadow-evidence schema used only format:date-time for generatedAt. A format-annotation-only consumer admitted arbitrary non-dates, offsets and noncanonical fractions that the runtime validator rejects; a standalone schema consumer could mistake malformed generation time for canonical metadata.
lesson: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 date-time format may be annotation only; shadow generatedAt cannot rely on format to enforce the runtime's canonical UTC millisecond spelling. A valid-looking generation timestamp is caller-controlled and not evidence of trusted capture time, independent issuer or final settlement.
guardrail: Pin the shadow generatedAt schema to an explicit four-digit-year, uppercase-T, three-digit-fraction UTC-Z lexical pattern, test positive and negative schema-only vectors without format assertion, and retain the runtime Date roundtrip for Gregorian validity. Never use generatedAt to authorize scoring or production.
